This editorial illustration features a central human figure in blue-toned skin tones, shown from behind but glancing over their shoulder. They wear glasses, a light blue long-sleeved shirt, dark pants, and blue boots. This figure holds large red bolt cutters positioned near a wire fence. To the left, two smaller male figures are in the background behind the fence: one in a red suit and one in a white shirt and dark pants, both appearing startled with raised hands.

The background is black above a red wire fence and a beige ground. Large red letters spell "TEMPO" across the top. White text overlays the main figure, reading "TABRAK ATURAN PULAU BUATAN." At the top, smaller text reads "REKENING JANGGAL PEJABAT BEA-CUKAI" and "ZIGZAG REGULASI MIGAS." A barcode at the bottom left includes the numbers "00029" and "9 770126 427302," alongside the date "11-17 SEPTEMBER 2017" and the price "RP 45.000." The image uses a limited palette of red, black, light blue, and beige.
